name: ShapeShift FOX Colony
rootCause: ShapeShift’s FOX Colony (a community governance and participation program for FOX token holders) on Arbitrum was exploited via a smart contract vulnerability in its Colony Network contracts. The attacker drained approximately $132.7K in USDC and FOX tokens in a single sophisticated transaction by exploiting a meta-transaction self-call flaw combined with DSAuth authorization logic. The core exchange platform was unaffected; this impacted the DAO/community treasury.

descriptions.text: ShapeShift’s FOX Colony (a community governance and participation program for FOX token holders) on Arbitrum was exploited via a smart contract vulnerability in its Colony Network contracts. The attacker drained approximately $132.7K in USDC and FOX tokens in a single sophisticated transaction by exploiting a meta-transaction self-call flaw combined with DSAuth authorization logic. The core exchange platform was unaffected; this impacted the DAO/community treasury.

ShapeShift’s FOX Colony treasury contracts on Arbitrum were exploited on 2026-05-13 through a meta-transaction authorization flaw in Colony Network’s EtherRouter architecture. Public analyses report that the attacker used executeMetaTransaction to trigger an internally authorized self-call, replace the contract resolver with malicious routing logic, and drain roughly $132,700 in USDC and FOX tokens. Public postmortems attribute the exploit to an authorization bypass created by the interaction between Colony Network’s executeMetaTransaction meta-transaction flow and the legacy DSAuth authorization model.
